description: This PHP source file is part of the vtiger CRM system, handling the process of merging duplicate account records. It includes operations such as saving merged records, transferring related data, and displaying merge-related interfaces.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering CRM-specific templates in the application.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from duplicate entries to the primary record during merge operations.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a CRM entity record identified by its module and record ID.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Fetches values for given record IDs from the database for the specified module.
